comment: Which copies of the Hermes plugin scanner scripts/guard_scan.py runs. Each is fetched at the commit named here, so a CI run is reproducible; the scheduled run fetches the branch named under latest instead. The gate decides what a verdict means (the web client plan's W3, amended for HERM-192): the fork, which is what the gateways run at install and update, is blocking and passes only on safe; upstream, which the fork tracks, is informational: it runs, its verdict and findings are reported, and only dangerous from it fails. The app repository pins the same two commits in scripts/web/scanner-pins.json. To move a pin, change the commit in a pull request of its own and read the scanner's report on that run. CONTRIBUTING.md says how.
